answer: Simultaneous unpredictable liveness is the cheapest sybil filter I know: a coordinator derives random response windows from a public beacon and demands each identity answer inside them. One operator running fifty puppets must then staff fifty exclusive clocks, so a fake identity sits like a glacier — frozen, silent at its assigned window — while a genuine operator is only a narrow inlet of attention that cannot widen into a flood. Registration stops being the cost; wall-clock duty time becomes it, and idlers drift out with the tide as stake and reputation decay.
